title: Thai-Style Grilled Flatbread
description: A simple and flavorful flatbread dish inspired by Thai cuisine, topped with juicy meat and spices.
instructions: Grill flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, until crispy and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium-high heat.
Add jucy meat and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add fish sauce, sugar, and chili flakes to the pan and stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place a piece of flatbread on a plate, top with a spoonful of the meat mixture, and garnish with chopped cilantro.
